fieldEditor.clickToRelabel: Click to rename this field's display label
fieldEditor.renameCodeConsequenceLive: This renames the database column on a form that already holds data. Every existing value is kept. Anything outside this platform that reads the column by its old name - Power BI queries, Tableau, exports, integrations - will stop finding it until you update them.
fieldEditor.renameCodeConsequenceDraft: This form hasn't been published yet, so no column exists and no data is at risk. The new code is what the column will be created as at first publish.
fieldEditor.changeTypeConsequenceLive: This converts every existing value in the column to the new type. If even one value can't be converted, nothing is changed and you'll be told which records are in the way - values are never silently dropped or truncated to make a conversion fit.
fieldEditor.changeTypeConsequenceDraft: This form hasn't been published yet, so there's no data to convert - only the field's definition changes.
fieldEditor.chooseLookupTarget: Choose a form to look up…
fieldEditor.dropdownTypeUnsupported: Converting a field to Dropdown needs an options list, which this editor can't collect yet. Add a new Dropdown field instead, then archive this one.
fieldEditor.archiveConsequenceLive: The field disappears from the form and stops accepting new entries. Its column and every value already recorded stay exactly as they are, so past records keep their history. You can restore it later, with the data intact.
fieldEditor.archiveConsequenceDraft: The field is hidden from the form. You can restore it at any time.
fieldEditor.deleteConsequenceLive: This drops the column and every value ever recorded in it. It cannot be undone - not by restoring, not by republishing. Only do this for data that should never have been collected. Type {{code}} below to confirm.
fieldEditor.deleteConsequenceDraft: This form has never been published, so there's no column and no data - the field is simply removed.
fieldEditor.renameCodeError: Could not rename this field's code.
fieldEditor.changeTypeError: Could not change this field's type.
